primary_comparison: Paired sweep minus opposite-L1 absolute bps error on eligible cross-L1 prints, summarized per day and in nonoverlapping five-minute blocks.
shared_sample: All five delays must be price-eligible; shared_cross_l1 additionally requires the print to cross L1 in every delay's state.
quantiles: Not computed in the streaming summary. Preserve every print and exact integer/rational prices in Parquet for subsequent exact quantiles; no sampling or sketch approximation.
interpretation: Conditional print-price diagnostic using observed taker side and size, not parent-order fill validation or an ex-ante trade forecast.
freeze_policy: Config and all executed source files must match committed Git blobs before any raw-market parsing. Prepare a hash-bound receipt before the frozen Nov 1 00:00-01:00 UTC smoke.
event_test_policy: The runner rejects development and event_test before input access. Auxiliary studies are outside this execution configuration.
